Commission Recommendation on access to and preservation of scientific information 2012
annotation.summary_en: Estonian Research Council expert group's 2016 principles and recommendations for a national open science policy, covering open access to publicly funded research publications and data, licensing, repositories, data management plans, stakeholder roles and a 2016–2020 implementation schedule. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2020 publicly funded articles should be open access within one year at most, with at least half immediately open.
Open access must be included in public research funding conditions.
Funding applications must include data management plans with licensing information.
Prefer CC BY licences, persistent identifiers and machine-readable metadata.
ETIS to serve as central repository; open access share rises to 50% then 75% by 2018–2020.
